documents.title: Intimation Regarding Issuance And Allotment Of Commercial Paper Amounting To Rs. 150 Crores
Board Meeting Intimation for Notice Of Board Meeting
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
Intimation of Repayment of Commercial Paper (CP)
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Management reported a consolidated revenue of INR 1,432 Crores, EBITDA of INR 313 Crores with a 22% margin, and PAT of INR 228 Crores with a 16% margin for Q1FY27. The company announced strategic growth initiatives including indigenous Carbon Nanotube (CNT) technology with a 200 MTPA facility and an entry into Super Speciality Carbon Black via capacity conversion. Management highlighted ongoing progress in new energy materials like anode active material and LFP cathode chemistry expansion plans, alongside the operational turnaround of Birla Tyres. Himadri Speciality Chemical Ltd reported its Q1FY27 financial results, recording year-on-year growth across revenue, EBITDA, and PAT. Management highlighted progress in its strategic diversification into advanced carbon materials, lithium-ion battery components such as anode and LFP cathode materials, and carbon nanotubes.

guidance.claim: The company expects to achieve around 3,000 crores of top line from the Birla Tyres business in the next 4 years.
guidance.quote: Birla Tyres top line contribution for this year was INR 187 crores, and we expect to be around INR 3,000 crores of top line from this business in next 4 years.

guidance.claim: Management has committed to doubling the FY25 PAT of INR 555 crores in the next three years to INR 1,100 plus crores by FY28.
guidance.quote: See, again, coming to that, I have given a guidance that FY25 we had a PAT of INR 555 crores. We have committed to double this PAT in next three years in FY28 to INR 1,100 plus crores.

demand_outlook.claim: Global lithium-ion battery demand is projected to rise significantly from around 1.6 terawatt hours in 2025 to nearly 6.8 terawatt hours by 2035.
demand_outlook.quote: Global lithium-ion battery demand is projected to rise from around 1.6 terawatt hours in 2025 to nearly 6.8 terawatt hours by 2035.

demand_outlook.claim: Customer engagements with leading Indian and global cell manufacturers have intensified significantly regarding LFP chemistry.
demand_outlook.quote: Customer engagements have intensified significantly with leading Indian as well as global cell manufacturers, and the response has been strongly encouraging.

demand_outlook.claim: Birla Tyres has established a strong and expanding network of 43 distributors and over 1,000 dealers.
demand_outlook.quote: From a distributor standpoint, we have established a strong and expanding network of 43 distributors and over 1,000 dealers giving us a solid platform for scale.

capex_expansion.claim: The upcoming 200 MTPA CNT manufacturing facility has a planned capex of approximately INR 70 Crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Backed by a planned capex of approximately INR70 Crores, our upcoming 200 MTPA CNT manufacturing facility targeted for commissioning in Q4FY27, is expected to position Himadri among a select group of few global manufacturers serving this high-growth market.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is converting 6,000 MTPA of existing capacity with a capex of INR 170 Crores for Super Speciality Carbon Black.
capex_expansion.quote: We are converting 6,000 MTPA of existing capacity with a capex of INR170 Crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The initial 2,000 MTPA capacity for LFP cathode chemistry represents the first milestone under Phase 1 of a 40,000 MTPA expansion plan.
capex_expansion.quote: Our initial 2,000 MTPA capacity is expected to be commissioned in Q3FY27, representing the first milestone under Phase 1 of our 40,000 MTPA expansion plan, which forms part of our broader long-term vision to scale capacity to 200,000 MTPA.

capex_expansion.claim: Specialty chemicals phase 1 capex is for 2,600 MTPA capacity with commissioning in Q2FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Speciality Chemicals: Anthraquinone + Carbazole Phase 1 capex of 2,600 MTPA capacity Commissioning Q2FY27

capex_expansion.claim: On 23rd April 2026, the company successfully commissioned operations at its first anode material manufacturing facility in Mahistikry with an initial capacity of 200 metric tons per annum.
capex_expansion.quote: On 23rd April 2026, we successfully commissioned operation at our first anode material manufacturing facility in Mahistikry, West Bengal with an initial capacity of 200 metric tons per annum, marking a pivotal step in our entry into lithium-ion battery materials value chain.

capex_expansion.claim: Execution of Phase 1 of the lithium-ion phosphate cathode active material project is on track for a total capacity of 40,000 metric tons per annum.
capex_expansion.quote: Execution of Phase 1 of our lithium-ion phosphate cathode active material project, which envisages a total capacity of 40,000 metric tons per annum is on track.

capex_expansion.claim: During the year, the company commissioned an additional 70,000 metric ton speciality carbon black facility at Mahistikry, taking total speciality carbon black capacity to 130,000 metric tons per annum.
capex_expansion.quote: During the year, we successfully commissioned an additional 70,000 metric ton speciality carbon black facility at Mahistikry, taking our total speciality carbon black capacity to 130,000 metric tons per annum and our overall carbon black capacity to 250,000 metric ton per annum.

capex_expansion.claim: The anthraquinone and carbazole project is progressing as planned and is expected to commission in Q2 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Looking ahead, our anthraquinone and carbazole project is progressing as planned and expected to commission in Q2 FY27, helping address a significant import dependency in India.

margins_costs.claim: Outbound freight is part of other expenses, which has come down and helped reduce costs.
margins_costs.quote: So freight outbound is part of other expenses, which has come down, which has helped us to reduce this cost.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that the business remains structurally insulated from West Asian geopolitical volatility as it does not depend on that region for core feedstock or operations.
margins_costs.quote: Turning to the operating environment, recent geopolitical developments in West Asia have introduced volatility in energy prices and logistics. However, our business remains structurally insulated as we are not dependent on that region for our core feedstock or operations.

margins_costs.claim: The company reported its strongest financial performance to date, with consolidated EBITDA standing at INR 1,006 crores, PBT at INR 1,001 crores, and PAT at INR 755 crores for FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Financially, we delivered our strongest performance to date. On a consolidated basis, EBITDA stood at INR 1,006 crores, PBT at INR1,001 crores and Profit after Tax at INR 755 crores, reflecting the strength of our value-added portfolio, operational discipline and consistent focus on in-house innovation.

margins_costs.claim: The average EBITDA per metric ton across the entire portfolio was around INR 17,000 per metric ton.
margins_costs.quote: And EBITDA in terms of if you look at our EBITDA per metric ton, it was around INR17,000 per metric ton on an average on the entire basket of portfolio.

orders_capacity.claim: The company operates with 250,000 metric ton capacity, including 130,000 tons of speciality carbon black capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: With 250,000 metric ton capacity, including 130,000 tons of speciality carbon black capacity, we operate across a product portfolio of more than 70 speciality grades.

orders_capacity.claim: The company operates the world's largest single location fully integrated carbon complex, with 600,000 MTPA of coal tar distillation capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: We operate the world's largest single location fully integrated carbon complex, with 600,000 MTPA of coal tar distillation capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: Himadri operates eight zero-discharge plants across India and China.
orders_capacity.quote: 8 zero discharge plants across India & China

orders_capacity.claim: The company has a coal tar distillation capacity of 600,000 MTPA.
orders_capacity.quote: 600,000 MTPA of coal tar distillation capacity

orders_capacity.claim: The company holds a 65% domestic market share in coal tar pitch.

capital_allocation.claim: The total capex announced is around INR 2,000 Crores, consisting of INR 1,125 Crores for LFP, INR 368 Crores announced yesterday, and INR 500 Crores of capex this year in Birla Tyres.
capital_allocation.quote: Yes, total capex we have announced is around INR2,000 Crores, INR1,125 Crores for LFP, INR368 Crores announced yesterday. So that brings to around INR1,500 Crores of capex, plus INR500 Crores of capex this year in Birla Tyres. So total INR2,000 Crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's investments are self-funded to unlock new opportunities.
capital_allocation.quote: Self funded investments; unlocking new opportunities

capital_allocation.claim: As of 31st March 2026, the company holds a net positive cash balance of INR 121 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: As of 31st March 2026, we hold a net positive cash balance of INR 121 crores, which gives us ample flexibilities to pursue growth opportunities while maintaining a prudent approach to capital allocation.

capital_allocation.claim: The total capital expenditure incurred for the 40,000 metric ton cathode facility is INR 1,125 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: What will be the total capex incurred for this 40,000? Anurag Choudhary: INR 1125 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: Forward-looking statements are subject to known and unknown risks, uncertainties, and assumptions that are difficult to predict.
risks_headwinds.quote: Such forward-looking statements are not guarantees of future performance and are subject to known and unknown risks, uncertainties and assumptions that are difficult to predict.

risks_headwinds.claim: Recent geopolitical developments in West Asia have introduced volatility in energy prices and logistics.
risks_headwinds.quote: Turning to the operating environment, recent geopolitical developments in West Asia have introduced volatility in energy prices and logistics.

management_commitments.claim: The 200 MTPA CNT manufacturing facility is targeted for commissioning in Q4FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Backed by a planned capex of approximately INR70 Crores, our upcoming 200 MTPA CNT manufacturing facility targeted for commissioning in Q4FY27, is expected to position Himadri among a select group of few global manufacturers serving this high-growth market.

management_commitments.claim: The initial 2,000 MTPA LFP capacity is expected to be commissioned in Q3FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Our initial 2,000 MTPA capacity is expected to be commissioned in Q3FY27, representing the first milestone under Phase 1 of our 40,000 MTPA expansion plan, which forms part of our broader long-term vision to scale capacity to 200,000 MTPA.

management_commitments.claim: Full commissioning of forward integration into anthraquinone and carbazole is targeted by FY28.
management_commitments.quote: Our forward integration into anthraquinone and carbazole with a total capacity of 5,300 MTPA is progressing well with full commissioning targeted by FY28.

management_commitments.claim: Birla Tyres' next strategic milestone is the commissioning of the Passenger Car Radial (PCR) facility by FY28.
management_commitments.quote: Birla Tyres' next strategic milestone is the commissioning of Passenger Car Radial (PCR) facility by FY28, paving the way for its planned entry into EV and SUV tyre segments.

management_commitments.claim: The first milestone capacity of 2,000 metric tons of the LFP cathode project is targeted for commissioning by Q3 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: As part of this phased execution, the first milestone capacity of 2,000 metric tons is targeted for commissioning by Q3 FY27.

management_commitments.claim: FY29 is envisaged as the year for full Phase 1 operations of the LFP project.
management_commitments.quote: The balance Phase 1 capacity will be progressively brought onstream over the subsequent 12 months, closely aligned with customer approvals and demand visibility, with FY29 envisaged as the year for full Phase 1 operations.

management_commitments.claim: Capacity expansion at Sicona is currently underway and targeted for completion by Q2 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: During the year, Sicona has achieved important milestones at pilot scale level, with further capacity expansion currently underway and targeted for completion by Q2 FY27, supporting intensified engagement with global cell manufacturers across multiple stages of sample approvals.

management_commitments.claim: Over the next 12 to 24 months, the company will progressively enhance capacity utilization in the Birla Tyres business.
management_commitments.quote: Over the next 12 to 24 months, we will be progressively enhance our capacity utilization, supported by robust pipeline of new product launches across agriculture, mining and commercial vehicle segments.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets to commission passenger car radial (PCR) capacity in the next 24 months.
management_commitments.quote: PCR, we target to commission in next 24 months.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
